text.p: European Cup survivors Ajax were held 1-1 by 10-man AZ Alkmaar in the Dutch league on Sunday.

Ajax seemed set for maximum points after moving ahead in the 11th minute when Arno Splinter's shot deflected into goal and Alkmaar's Danny Hesp was sent off for bringing down Nordin Wooter after 30 minutes.
But lowly AZ fought hard and were rewarded in the 55th minute when Krzystof Bociek jumped high to head home an equaliser.
Ajax woes increased when midfielder Arnold Scholten received his fourth yellow card of the season and must serve a one-game suspension and Tijjani Babangida went off with concussion.
Ajax were left in sixth place, 15 points behind leaders PSV Eindhoven who thrashed Volendam 6-0 on Saturday.
Feyenoord remained second, six points adrift, with a 4-0 victory at Graafschap Doetinchem. Argentine Pablo Sanchez scored twice and Henke Larsson and Ronald Koeman once.
Home fans hurled abuse at the referee in the game between NEC Nijmegen and NAC Breda -- so he walked off the pitch. The second half finally resumed after a 17-minute stoppage and NEC crashed 3-0.
